item.title: We say ‘Never again’ as we remember the Holocaust. But what do we do to make it true?
item.description: (RNS) — As the author’s state of Maine reckons with how to protect a threatened group of neighbors, she’s guided by those who helped her own family. The post We say ‘Never again’ as we remember the Holocaust. But what do we do to make it true? appeared first on RNS.

item.title: In new letter, Orthodox rabbis say Jewish law forbids ‘conversion therapy’
item.description: (RNS) — About 100 Orthodox rabbis from the U.S. and Israel say the practice is harmful and doesn't work. The post In new letter, Orthodox rabbis say Jewish law forbids ‘conversion therapy’ appeared first on RNS.

item.description: (RNS) — ‘The current climate of fear and polarization, which thrives when human dignity is disregarded, does not meet the standard set by Christ in the Gospel,’ wrote Oklahoma City Archbishop Paul Coakley. item.title: Trump’s framing of Nigeria insurgency as a war on Christians risks undermining interfaith peacebuilding
item.description: (The Conversation) — President Donald Trump described a Dec. 25 airstrike on suspected insurgent camps as a ‘Christmas present’ from the US. Many in Nigeria are not viewing it as such. The post Trump’s framing of Nigeria insurgency as a war on Christians risks undermining interfaith peacebuilding appeared first on RNS.

item.title: Top Vatican official calls violence in Minneapolis ‘unacceptable’
item.description: VATICAN CITY (RNS) — Cardinal Pietro Parolin urges restraint by federal agents as Catholic bishops in the United States criticize immigration enforcement tactics. The post Top Vatican official calls violence in Minneapolis ‘unacceptable’ appeared first on RNS.

item.title: As Jews mark Tu Bishvat, the EPA turns its back on the Earth and public health
item.description: (RNS) — Led by its first-ever Jewish administrator, the EPA is planning to repeal a landmark determination that greenhouse gases pose a threat to public health and welfare. The post As Jews mark Tu Bishvat, the EPA turns its back on the Earth and public health appeared first on RNS.

item.title: Maine clergy form spiritual ‘shield’ outside workplaces to protect immigrants from ICE
item.description: (RNS) — Like religious leaders in cities such as Minneapolis, Chicago and elsewhere, local clergy were quick to muster resistance to the rapid influx of immigration enforcement agents, even as they wrangle with the unusual geography of Maine. The post Maine clergy form spiritual ‘shield’ outside workplaces to protect immigrants from ICE appeared first on RNS.
